verdict.rationale: Together AI's docs explicitly state you can 'Call chat, image, audio, embedding, and more through one API' on the serverless platform, indicating multimodal model support beyond text chat on the same platform [together-ai-docs-21]. This is corroborated by the broader serverless/dedicated inference docs describing a unified API/base URL approach [together-ai-docs-1, together-ai-docs-2]. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on report or example code specifically calling vision/audio/image-generation endpoints, and no detailed model list confirming breadth of non-text modalities.
